blurb: Browns Lake Golf Course’s manicured fairways and contoured greens stretch for 6,449 challenging yards. Opened in 1926 the course has had 90 years to mature and provides a memorable experience for all players. Our friendly and courteous staff will cater to your needs as you prepare for you round.
